metadata.datasource: Characteristic curves, spectral sensitivities from Konica, Konica Color CENTURIA SUPER 100 technical data sheet (2002), CNK-4 (C-41), Status M; its spectral sensitivities read at density 1.0 above D-min. The curves were read from the vector plot, each layer by its dash pattern, and converted from Status M densities into dye amounts. Mid-grey where a meter set to EI 100 puts it on the sheet's absolute axis (log H -1.090 lux-seconds). Past its plotted ends each sensitivity continues at its own final gradient, to three decades under its peak, and they are balanced so an 18% grey exposes every layer equally. The base density is the sheet's own D-min spectral density, base and fog, and the profile keeps its midscale neutral. The sheet plots no single-dye spectra: the dyes are those of the agx reference profile 'fujifilm_xtra_400', whose dyes, refined, fit all three of Konica's sheets here (CENTURIA SUPER 100 and 1600, IMPRESA 50) closely with small moves, as one family, each moved and stretched about its peak until the three add up to it: cyan -0.3 nm x0.977, magenta -0.1 nm x1.022, yellow -1.1 nm x1.155. No spectral adaptation window: agx fits one to each of its own stocks' sensitivities. DIR coupler model from 'fujifilm_xtra_400'.
